one_liner: Salesforce B2C Commerce exposes broad REST APIs (SCAPI/OCAPI) with Account Manager OAuth clients, but you need a B2C Commerce instance bought through Salesforce sales.
auth_notes: Account Manager API clients issue OAuth 2.1-style scoped JWT bearer tokens. Admin APIs use client credentials, and SLAS gives shopper tokens. Clients are created by an administrator in Account Manager, so a self-serve user-authorization flow is limited. The auth_primary of OAUTH2 is a judgment call.
access_notes: The API is at no extra cost for B2C Commerce customers. Getting an instance means contacting Salesforce sales. No free or trial path appears in the evidence.
blocker_notes: A B2C Commerce instance and realm are needed to create API clients. The only access route in the evidence is contacting Salesforce sales, from a third-party guide.

evidence.quote: Both the Admin and Shopper APIs are authorized using an access token in the form of a JSON Web Token (JWT).

The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
The B2C Commerce MCP Service is a fully-hosted service for linking an AI agent to real-time B2C Commerce data access.
